# v0.3.0-alpha.1 — 身份分析与受控验证

本Alpha候选来源`26656db690d594bebcf2d69d273bfcd5dfc376bc`，[CI39616530060](https://github.com/Aleka579/VMIL/actions/runs/39616530060)实际通过240单元/206模拟集成，Release零警告/错误。原CI产品artifact12354145051为65,286,300字节/413文件，SHA256 `b607f1cb61b16c19e2fd788a5dfa3f45f0ef74ca3117bc8d170e9072e73ef779`。普通权限Win11 Build26100宿主14项CLI/PNG、43项双语GUI，以及Win10教育版Build18363/x64客户机28/50项均通过；413文件/原ZIP测试后不变，最后证据归档后仅新测试目录和凭据会话清理，VM保持运行。实际SDK10.0.402/两自包含运行时10.0.13；测试接入、定位与退出记录器的原失败及局部修正见[客户机验收记录](https://github.com/Aleka579/VMIL/blob/codex/release-v03-alpha1-20261022/docs/V03-M13-CI-GUEST-ACCEPTANCE.md)。

本版加入可选脱敏UUID/MAC/BIOS序列号分析、只读实验计划、已有静态MAC/BIOS UUID的有限官方API应用/历史/单键恢复，以及私有前/后/恢复后三阶段验证和脱敏JSON/HTML结论。默认诊断1.0兼容，C#14/.NET10/WPF架构保持；自包含运行时及Windows采集依赖10.0.13。

身份写入只允许Workstation17.5.2.23775571/vmrest1.3.1.23775571、hardware19、有效已有MAC和UUID、唯一静态hostonly网卡且启动断开，一次一个已有字段。数值范围保持原4096↔6144MiB、2↔4vCPU及每插槽2核策略。应用/恢复均需可靠关机、新预览、明确确认、备份、持久intent及官方API复核。备份不是整机恢复，App租约不是VMware全局锁；未决操作不盲重试。

其他构建、自动地址、多网卡/联网、缺失键、生成/复制流程及多字段恢复未准入；全新OS及其他目标未验证则不扩大声明。私有快照含原始标识，禁止公开上传；默认诊断和验证结论脱敏、无遥测。MAC/UUID改变后其他虚拟化证据仍在，不保证第三方程序识别为物理机，不得用于绕过反作弊、反欺诈、封禁、授权或安全保护。

拟提供原CI产品ZIP、ZIP SHA256和逐文件SHA256三资产。MIT，Copyright (c) 2026 Daniel Waltz，保留第三方许可。漏洞报告由Daniel Waltz通过[GitHub私密渠道](https://github.com/Aleka579/VMIL/security/advisories/new)维护。

## English

This alpha candidate uses public source26656db and [CI39616530060](https://github.com/Aleka579/VMIL/actions/runs/39616530060): zero build warnings/errors, 240 unit and 206 simulated integration tests passed. The unchanged original artifact12354145051 is 65,286,300 bytes with 413 files, SHA256 b607f1cb61b16c19e2fd788a5dfa3f45f0ef74ca3117bc8d170e9072e73ef779, SDK10.0.402/runtime10.0.13. Ordinary-user acceptance passed 14 CLI/PNG and 43 bilingual App checks on Windows11 build26100, plus 28/50 checks on Windows10 Education build18363 x64. All product files and the original ZIP remained unchanged. Final evidence was archived before removing the new test directory and ending credentials; the VM remained running. Initial test-access, row-lookup and exit-recorder failures are preserved with their corrections in the acceptance record. The first App exit code remains unknown; a separate normal launch/close check recorded zero.

This alpha adds opt-in redacted identity analysis, unexecuted experiment plans, finite official-API transactions/history/single-field restoration for existing static MAC/BIOS UUID, and private before/after/restored validation with redacted JSON/HTML conclusions. Diagnostic schema1.0 and the .NET10/WPF architecture are retained; self-contained runtime and Windows collection packages use10.0.13.

Identity admission is limited to the exact Workstation17.5.2.23775571/vmrest1.3.1.23775571/hardware19 build, both valid existing identities and one static host-only NIC disconnected at startup, one existing field per transaction. Numeric admission retains4096↔6144MiB,2↔4vCPU and two cores per socket. Fresh preview, explicit confirmation, power-off, verified backup, durable intent and API readback remain required. Backups are not whole-VM recovery and the App lease is not a global VMware lock. Preserve unresolved records; do not blindly retry.

Other builds/topologies, connectivity, automatic addresses, missing keys, generated/copied identities and multi-field restoration are not admitted. Private snapshots contain raw identifiers; keep them private. Other VMware evidence remains and physical-machine classification is not guaranteed. Do not evade anti-cheat, anti-fraud, bans, licensing or security protections. Planned assets are original CI ZIP, ZIP checksum and per-file checksums. Original code is MIT, Copyright(c)2026 Daniel Waltz; retain third-party licenses. Daniel Waltz maintains the [private security channel](https://github.com/Aleka579/VMIL/security/advisories/new).
